newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl and Aznar to meet in Bonn on January 30.
newsitem.headline: Kohl and Aznar to meet in Bonn on January 30.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar will hold talks in Bonn on January 30, with reform of the European Union likely to top the agenda, a government spokesman said on Monday.
Aznar will be accompanied by 11 cabinet ministers who will meet their German counterparts.

The spokesman said a large part of the talks would revolve around preparations for an EU summit in Amsterdam in June. Member countries are due to approve a reform of the EU to prepare for the admission of east European countries.
German-Spanish consultations are normally held on a loose annual basis. The latest round of talks was postponed from the end of last year because of difficulties finding a suitable date.
